about.title: A developer who sees the whole picture.
paragraphs: I’m Zayed, a full-stack developer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. I work across MERN and PERN stacks, bringing user interfaces, APIs, and data models together.

In my previous role at SoftVence, I worked with clients and teammates to understand requirements, discuss solutions, share progress, and support delivery. That experience taught me to connect technical work with real business needs.
I’m now looking for a developer role where I can contribute that experience, take responsibility for my work, and keep growing with a team.

experience.title: Jr Full Stack Developer
highlights: Developed full-stack applications with React, Next.js, Redux, NestJS, and Node.js.
Worked directly with clients to clarify requirements, discuss proposals and technical decisions, communicate progress, and support product delivery.
Implemented real-time WebSocket communication and scheduled background workflows.
Designed database schemas and caching layers with PostgreSQL, Prisma, MongoDB, and Redis.
Integrated Stripe and SSLCommerz payment workflows with webhook handling.

education.description: An analytical foundation in mathematical modeling, systematic reasoning, and breaking complex problems into smaller parts.

principles.title: Extreme ownership
principles.description: I take responsibility for the client’s brief, the quality of my work, and following through on what we agree—from planning to post-launch support.

principles.title: Disciplined execution
principles.description: I rely on consistent effort and focused execution: breaking complex work into clear milestones, investigating problems methodically, and following agreed priorities.

principles.title: Clear communication & teamwork
principles.description: I listen to clients, explain technical choices in plain language, and keep teammates aligned on decisions, progress, and blockers.

principles.title: Professionalism & integrity
principles.description: I communicate honestly about scope and trade-offs, handle data responsibly, and leave software understandable for the next developer.
